description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called MenuContent, which manages the content of a menu bar extra for the OpenClaw application. It includes UI elements for connection status, control toggles, and debug options, as well as internal logic for microphone management, settings navigation, and health status updates.

classes.name: MenuContent
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that provides a menu interface for the OpenClaw application, including connection controls, status indicators, debugging options, and microphone management.

methods.name: loadMicrophones
methods.description: Loads available microphone devices, optionally forcing a refresh, and updates the available microphone list.

methods.name: saveBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Saves the current browser control enabled setting to persistent storage.

methods.name: loadBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Loads the browser control enabled setting from persistent storage.

methods.name: presentDebugResult
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog with the result of a debug action, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Navigates to a specified settings tab, opening the settings window.

methods.name: openDashboard
methods.description: Opens the dashboard URL in the system's default web browser.
